description: This file defines a Python class `AmazonBedrockOpenAIConfig` that manages configuration, URL construction, request signing, and request transformation for Bedrock imported models that use the OpenAI Chat Completions format. It extends existing classes to add Bedrock-specific logic for handling AWS endpoints, request signing with SigV4, and input/output transformations.
